notes: All four specimens compared. Accepted coherent THX whole construction: left three-bar vertical component; branched right upper stem with a short horizontal and two independently detached cup forms.
Each upper cup retains its small closed counter and its two open rising ends. Middle lozenge contains a free upward tip from the lower stem; it does not fully divide the lozenge into two counters.
Lower right construction retains its curved upper return, vertical course and three right-projecting horizontal levels; the lower two rectangular fields stay open.
Left lowest bar is longest; middle bar remains shorter. Right lowest projecting bar is longest and upper levels remain shorter. None of the small upper counters or lozenge opening is lost.
